notes: Actual results for the fiscal year ended January 31, 2024, as the county reported them to the Census Bureau's Annual Survey of State and Local Government Finances. Not a budget.
Vermont counties are small: Caledonia County runs the courthouse and the sheriff's department, paid for by a county tax its towns collect. Towns, cities and villages provide most local services.
Covers every fund, including water, sewer, electric and other utilities. Debt service counts interest and principal repaid; borrowing and transfers between funds are left out.
Courts, legal services, public buildings, housing and community development count as overhead.
Debt is long-term debt outstanding plus short-term debt at year end.
Political money is not scored: the Secretary of State's campaign finance system refused connections from the build environment, and most town candidates do not file there.
Transparency practices have not been checked yet, so they are not scored.

notes: Actual results for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023, as the town reported them to the Census Bureau's Annual Survey of State and Local Government Finances. Not a budget.
The Census surveys every government only in Census of Governments years (2022) and a sample in other years, so FY 2023 is the latest available.

Public schools are run by a separate school district and funded through the statewide Education Fund. The town bills the education property tax with its own and pays it over; residents pay both, but only the town's own share is counted here.
Covers every fund, including water, sewer, electric and other utilities. Debt service counts interest and principal repaid; borrowing and transfers between funds are left out.
Courts, legal services, public buildings, housing and community development count as overhead.
Debt is long-term debt outstanding plus short-term debt at year end.
Political money is not scored: the Secretary of State's campaign finance system refused connections from the build environment, and most town candidates do not file there.
Transparency practices have not been checked yet, so they are not scored.
